prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 异常长值 · 标签列中的一个长值 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 230px
  col 2: header "级别" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
  col 3: header "人口（万）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 200px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按城市列出级别、人口和备注，便于比较各城市，并呈现一条名称和级别描述都异常长的记录。","reading":"读者先按城市定位行，再横向读取级别、人口和备注；比较人口时需要沿数值列向下扫描。长记录产生的行高可同时容纳该行其他单元格换行。","groups":["城市与级别共同标识和描述每条记录，适合相邻阅读。","人口是可纵向比较的数值；备注是补充说明，两列承担不同角色，但都需要与同一行的城市对应。"],"keep_intact":["人口数值及其数字序列","城市和级别名称的完整内容，换行时不截断或省略"],"may_wrap":["异常长的城市名称可在汉字之间换行","长级别描述可换行，并利用长城市名称形成的行高","备注可自然换行","空间紧张时，人口列标题可换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [100, 95, 98, 66] · table 360×418px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36, 176, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [75, 150, 77, 57] · table 360×441px · row heights [60, 36, 60, 36, 36, 176, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [145, 85, 77, 52] · table 360×441px · row heights [60, 36, 60, 36, 36, 176, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"人口标题保持一行，数值列整齐，普通记录的行高紧凑；城市和级别都有足够空间承载长记录，整体比另外两版更协调。","problems":"长记录的级别描述和备注都被切成许多短行，备注尤其呈现窄条状，读起来断续；长记录的行高主要由级别和备注共同撑起。","cause":"级别列为95px，内容区仅74px；备注列为66px，内容区仅45px。人口列98px保证了标题一行，但也占用了可分给文字列的空间。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"150px的级别列让长描述以较完整的语段呈现，人口数字仍可完整纵向比较。","problems":"城市长名称被切成很多短行，备注更显狭窄；人口标题换成两行，使所有列的表头一起增高。级别列的宽度没有降低长记录的整体行高，因为备注仍然很窄。","cause":"城市列仅75px、备注列仅57px；人口列77px的内容区不足以容纳完整标题。级别列150px挤占了其余列的空间。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"145px的城市列让长名称较容易辨认，普通城市名称和人口数字也清晰。","problems":"级别描述和备注都形成密集的短行，长记录右侧显得拥挤；人口标题换行增加了表头高度。城市列获得的宽度没有缩短这一行，因为级别和备注仍决定行高。","cause":"城市列145px，级别列仅85px，备注列仅52px；人口列77px不足以让标题保持一行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-header","widths":[90,105,98,66],"change":"以r0A为基础，将10px从城市列移到级别列。保留人口标题一行，同时让长级别描述有更完整的行；城市长名称仍可自然换行。"},{"name":"wider-notes","widths":[85,95,98,81],"change":"保留一行人口标题，将城市列的15px移给备注列。用较多的城市名称换行换取更舒展的备注，观察长记录是否因此更易横向阅读。"},{"name":"shared-width","widths":[90,105,83,81],"change":"允许人口标题换行，把省出的宽度分给级别和备注。虽然表头会增高，但两个长文字单元格可获得更宽的行，值得与一行表头方案比较。"}]}
